Where should your AI work?

This sets real routing, not a preference label. You can change it any time in Settings → AI.

On this device

Your local AI workspace is designed to keep supported processing on your device. AI runs through a local model; if none is available, requests fail here rather than being sent anywhere.

A local model server is running on this device with 4 models installed.

Keep it on this device
With approved cloud AI

Keep Private First routing, and allow an external provider you enable as a fallback when no local model can serve a request.

External providers are used only as a fallback, only once configured, and every response shows where it actually ran.

Allow approved cloud AI

Default is Private First: local processing is preferred wherever it can serve the request.

Medical Device Manufacturing v1.0.0. Product master and batch/lot traceability for device manufacturing.
